workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation host runtime discovery IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can validate supplied public-safe host candidate facts through the existing host runtime preflight and validation command chain. It still lacks an admitted public-safe discovery-facts contract that can derive those candidates from bounded documented-root and Windows registry observations.

splitDecision.reason: Host runtime discovery facts are the smallest useful step after host preflight command composition. The lane admits bounded public-safe candidate discovery without opening runtime validation execution, compare execution, LabVIEWCLI execution, Docker orchestration, terminal process wiring, file writes, package/bin publication, release, Marketplace, or source copying.
splitDecision.discoveryBoundary: derive public-safe host candidate facts from selected host facts plus bounded documented-root and Windows registry observations; do not retain raw private paths or raw registry output in public facts
splitDecision.windowsBootBoundary: no Windows boot is required for bridge or admission; a later proof turn may exercise this admitted discovery surface on Windows after public admission and implementation merge
doNotAdmitTogether: invocation of the existing compare runtime locator as an implementation shortcut
